name: lula
displayName: Lula - C++ in South African languages
description: Write C++ and Arduino code in all 10 written official South African languages: every Arduino-compatible board (Uno, Nano, Mega, Uno R4, Nano 33, ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico, STM32, ...), ROS 2, OpenCV, Eigen, CUDA and PyTorch, with error messages in your language and a full language server. Includes a South African Sign Language (SASL) sign-video dictionary.

commands.title: Lula: Convert C++ to Lula (isiZulu, Afrikaans, ...)
Lula: Show SASL sign for word under cursor
Lula: Build / upload to Arduino-compatible board
Lula: Choose Arduino board (Uno, ESP32, Pico, STM32, ...)

editor/context.when: resourceLangId == cpp || resourceLangId == c || resourceLangId == lula

lula.compilerPath.description: C++ compiler. For embedded targets use e.g. avr-g++ or arm-none-eabi-g++.

lula.defaultLanguage.description: Language used when the file name has no language code (robot.lula instead of robot.zu.lula).

lula.sasl.enabled.description: Offer South African Sign Language (SASL) sign videos when hovering keywords.

lula.sasl.showMissing.description: Also mention in the hover when no SASL sign has been recorded for a word yet.

lula.sasl.dictionaryPath.description: Folder with your own SASL dictionary (signs.json + videos/). Empty uses the one built into the extension.

lula.arduinoBoard.markdownDescription: Board for Arduino programs: `uno`, `nano`, `mega`, `leonardo`, `uno-r4-minima`, `uno-r4-wifi`, `nano-33-iot`, `nano-33-ble`, `pico`, `pico-w`, `pico-2`, `esp32`, `esp32-s3`, `esp32-c3`, `esp8266`, `stm32-bluepill`, `stm32-blackpill`, `nucleo-f401re`, or any full board name (FQBN) such as `arduino:samd:mkr1000`. Used for building, uploading and for checking errors as you type.

lula.arduinoPort.description: Default serial port for uploading to an Arduino (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3).

lula.diagnostics.onType.description: Check for errors while you type (not only when you save).

lula.diagnostics.delay.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before checking (milliseconds).

lula.messageLanguage.description: Language of error messages. 'auto' uses the file's language.

lula.inlayHints.cppNames.description: Show the C++ meaning next to each Lula word (useful when learning).
